verdict.rationale: Mesh exposes a broad first-party API that covers much of what the web app does. Customer creation and sync/async/batch screening, monitoring configuration, transaction processing, exports, case audit trails and role lookups all have endpoints, and the docs state that cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either in the web app or via the API. A published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema and webhooks back this up. However, API credentials (and their permissions and expiry) are documented only as generated in the web application under Settings, and nothing shows API equivalents for configuring the risk-score equation or creating screening configurations. missing for 10: API-based credential/permission management, evidenced API parity for risk-scoring and screening configuration, an explicit UI–API parity statement, independent hands-on corroboration.
